questions.question: Choose the synonym of "begin".
questions.explanation: Begin and start both mean to commence an action.

questions.question: Choose the antonym of "strong".
questions.explanation: Strong means having great power; its opposite is weak.

questions.question: Choose the synonym of "smart".
questions.explanation: Smart (in the sense of intelligent) means clever.

questions.question: Choose the antonym of "ancient".
questions.explanation: Ancient means very old; modern means of the present time.

questions.question: Choose the synonym of "huge".
questions.explanation: Huge and enormous both mean extremely large.

questions.question: Choose the antonym of "victory".
questions.explanation: Victory means winning; defeat means losing.

questions.question: Choose the synonym of "courageous".
questions.explanation: Courageous means having courage, i.e. brave.

questions.question: Choose the antonym of "generous".
questions.explanation: Generous means willing to give freely; stingy means unwilling to give.

questions.question: Choose the synonym of "conceal".
questions.explanation: To conceal is to keep something from being seen, i.e. to hide.

questions.question: Choose the antonym of "expand".
questions.explanation: To expand is to become larger; to contract is to become smaller.

questions.question: Choose the synonym of "tranquil".
questions.explanation: Tranquil means peaceful and quiet, i.e. calm.

questions.question: Choose the antonym of "scarce".
questions.explanation: Scarce means not enough; plentiful means more than enough.

questions.question: Choose the synonym of "obstinate".
questions.explanation: Obstinate means refusing to change one's mind, i.e. stubborn.

questions.question: Choose the antonym of "permanent".
questions.explanation: Permanent means lasting forever; temporary means lasting for a short time.

questions.question: Choose the synonym of "candid".
questions.explanation: Candid means open and honest in speech, i.e. frank.

questions.question: Choose the antonym of "diligent".
questions.explanation: Diligent means hard-working; lazy means unwilling to work.

questions.question: Choose the synonym of "mitigate".
questions.explanation: To mitigate is to make something less severe, i.e. to lessen it.

questions.question: Choose the antonym of "transparent".
questions.explanation: Transparent means allowing light to pass through so that things can be seen; opaque means not allowing this.

questions.question: Choose the synonym of "ephemeral".
questions.explanation: Ephemeral means lasting for a very short time.

questions.question: Choose the antonym of "zenith".
questions.explanation: Zenith is the highest point; nadir is the lowest point.
